architecture_binding.aggregate_workpackages_note: WORKPACKAGES.md still displays F2-WP-505 as NOT_STARTED; granular acceptance evidence outranks this stale aggregate surface.

critical_architecture_correction.finding: WP505 generation 1 is not an unimplemented blocker. It already deterministically clips an explicit AdaptiveComputePolicy against an exact Grid10Plan and validated ControlSnapshot and has repository-hosted component-CI acceptance.
critical_architecture_correction.consequence: Do not replace or complicate the accepted WP505 generation-1 allocator. Any UCB-like mechanism belongs, if it survives falsification, upstream as an OPTIONAL_NONAUTHORITATIVE_POLICY_PROPOSER for a future generation, never as the cap authority or direct GRID writer.

mapping.observed_boundary: Explicit typed frame and cycle permission envelope; no hidden inference, effects, completion or runtime credit.
mapping.ucb_mapping: Frame identity/generation/digest may scope a replay fixture or policy-proposal context. UCB must not infer world facts or broaden allowed exits/max_grid_cells.

mapping.observed_boundary: Validated read-only signal evaluation emits disposition WITHIN/DEGRADED/HARD_LIMIT/UNKNOWN and a regulation candidate; not a control writer.
mapping.ucb_mapping: Disposition is a deterministic safety-envelope input. HARD_LIMIT and UNKNOWN must constrain or stop adaptive exploration; a bandit score cannot override the snapshot disposition or policy identity/digest.

mapping.observed_boundary: Exact G1..G10 logical cells with per-cell work ceilings, max re-entry depth and global max_total_work_units, bound to SituationFrame and control policy identities.
mapping.ucb_mapping: This is the authoritative compute ceiling for the candidate layer. Dynamic scoring may rank already-admissible cells but must be clipped by plan max_total_work_units, per-cell max_work_units, re-entry depth and any stricter explicit allocation policy cap.

mapping.observed_boundary: Explicit deterministic rules choose max_active_cells, max_total_work_units, canonical cell priority and cell caps per ControlSnapshot disposition; builder emits immutable nonauthoritative ComputeAllocationCandidate.
mapping.ucb_mapping: Do not change G1. A future proposer may generate a candidate cell_priority or bounded per-cell proposal from admitted historical evaluation, but the existing deterministic builder remains the clipping/fail-closed boundary and requires an explicit frozen policy artifact.

proposed_future_shape.name: F2_ADAPTIVE_POLICY_PROPOSER_UCB_THIN/v0
inputs: admitted historical evaluation receipts with typed provenance/generation
frozen scoring parameters and evaluation window identity
proposed_future_shape.tie_break: canonical GRID10 cell order or explicitly frozen canonical order
proposed_future_shape.output: proposed priority/order plus score receipt only; never work/effect/completion authority
hard_fences: final work ceilings remain min(Grid10Plan ceiling, explicit AdaptiveComputePolicy ceiling, remaining global budget)
HARD_LIMIT_BREACH and UNKNOWN_REQUIRED_EVIDENCE cannot be relaxed by score
missing reward remains UNKNOWN and is not silently coerced to zero
model self-report, textual confidence or coherence is not an admitted reward by itself
adaptive state is rebuildable from exact admitted receipt identities or remains explicitly noncanonical
no full MABWiser, learned MoD router or PonderNet runtime dependency is justified at E2

deterministic_stop_conditions_for_experi: no admissible cell with positive remaining deterministic ceiling
ControlSnapshot disposition is HARD_LIMIT_BREACH or UNKNOWN_REQUIRED_EVIDENCE under an experiment policy that forbids further exploration
frozen marginal-value estimate falls below a frozen cost threshold
stop_semantics.non_authority: STOP terminates optional compute allocation only; it cannot mint task completion, world truth, effect success, goal satisfaction or canonical state.

reward_contract_requirements: reward record binds source receipt IDs/digests, metric schema/version, cell ID, workload/family identity and observed generation
reward values derive from measurable outcome/evidence deltas or declared evaluation functions, not narrative self-assessment
late or missing outcomes remain UNKNOWN
all normalization/clipping is deterministic and versioned
evaluation window is frozen per replay run to prevent order-dependent hidden updates
deterministic_replay_requirements: freeze ordered input trace corpus and all object digests
freeze scorer version, alpha, reward transform, threshold and tie-break order
rebuild all bandit statistics from the same ordered admitted receipts at run start
forbid wall-clock, process-random, network and mutable external state inputs
emit per-decision score vector, admissibility mask, chosen order, cap clipping and stop-reason receipt

counterhypothesis.statement: The accepted static deterministic AdaptiveComputePolicy with explicit priorities and thresholds will match or outperform a UCB proposer on F2 workloads while being simpler, more replay-stable and less vulnerable to reward Goodharting/nonstationarity.

falsifiers: same frozen trace plus same policy parameters yields different decision/stop receipts
any selected proposal exceeds Grid10Plan, ControlSnapshot or explicit AdaptiveComputePolicy restrictions
rarely observed but useful cells become persistently starved under the UCB arm-selection process
permutation/test-order changes materially alter results after rebuilding from the same canonical history
performance decays under a distribution shift because old reward means dominate
UCB fails to improve evidence/quality per consumed work unit over the accepted static deterministic baseline
policy-proposer complexity, latency or state burden exceeds measured benefit
next_gate: Offline fixed-corpus deterministic replay only: compare thin UCB proposer against accepted static WP505 policy under identical Grid10Plan/ControlSnapshot hard caps; record quality/evidence gain per work unit, starvation, replay identity and overhead; no effects and no production integration.
